integrity: The mathematical proof is analytic. The checker is corroborative and uses exact binary arithmetic; no finite test is used as a substitute for the all-instance proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the generalized surface-code incidence structure in the source and to its sector-wise CSS measurement reduction.
Minimizes counts of original vertex and face stabilizers, not arbitrary nonlocal observables, measured-qubit support, noise, or circuit depth.
The linear-time implementation assumes constant-time access to endpoint and incident-face data for each erased edge.
Does not assert correctability of an erasure pattern; the source's underlying correctability hypothesis remains required.
title: Linear-time minimum stabilizer selection for generalized surface-code erasures
